metadata_limitations: Some nutrients expose analysis method and eight data points, but the mapped nutrients do not share a complete common sample/method basis.
No per-row footnotes were present for the reviewed mapped nutrients.
The API response does not establish equivalence to Taiwanese cultivars.

decision.reason: Lineage metadata shows materially different derivation and data-point coverage, but cannot establish a sufficiently comparable or Taiwan-specific reference record; the Foundation record is not complete for all mapped nutrients, while SR Legacy provenance is sparse. Do not choose by recency or field coverage alone and do not merge rows.
decision.next_step: Search for another single authoritative, rights-reviewable record whose food scope and nutrient provenance can support an explicitly labelled raw per-100-g reference; otherwise keep bok choy unmatched. Only after a source is selected should an isolated reference-only API/UI contract be implemented.
